## Representative sample, NOT a capture from a particular device: written in the format the Arduino-ESP32 core 3.x prints before setup() with Core Debug Level set to Debug prints
## (source: arduino-esp32 cores/esp32/chip-debug-report.cpp). Lines starting with "##" are comments; "\x1b" stands for the ESC byte.

=========== Before Setup Start ===========
Chip Info:
------------------------------------------
  Model             : ESP32-S3
  Package           : 0
  Revision          : 0.02
  Cores             : 2
  CPU Frequency     : 240 MHz
------------------------------------------
Board Info:
------------------------------------------
  Arduino Board     : ESP32S3_DEV
  Arduino Variant   : esp32s3
  Arduino FQBN      : esp32:esp32:esp32s3
============ Before Setup End ============
